data.name: Going
data.comment: A stage of the Migrations window's work under way, as its progress says it ({stage}, the stage's words).

data.name: ListingStage
data.comment: The stage of listing a context's migrations.

data.name: AddingStage
data.comment: The stage of adding a migration of that name.

data.name: RemovingStage
data.comment: The stage of removing a context's last migration.

data.name: UpdatingStage
data.value: {target, select, latest {Updating the database to the latest migration} none {Updating the database to before the first migration} other {Updating the database to {migration}}}
data.comment: The stage of updating the database: to the latest migration, to before the first (none), or to the migration named.

data.name: ScriptingStage
data.comment: The stage of writing a SQL script of migrations.

data.name: BundlingStage
data.comment: The stage of bundling migrations into a program that applies them.

data.name: NoDbContext
data.comment: A listing that found no EF Core context in the project.

data.name: NoMigrations
data.comment: A listing of a context with no migration.

data.name: MigrationsUnread
data.value: {context}: {count, plural, one {# migration} other {# migrations}}; the database could not be read
data.comment: A listing of a context's migrations whose database could not be read, so which are applied is not known.

data.name: MigrationsApplied
data.value: {context}: {count, plural, one {# migration} other {# migrations}}, all applied
data.comment: A listing of a context's migrations, every one applied to the database.

data.name: MigrationsPending
data.value: {context}: {count, plural, one {# migration} other {# migrations}}, {pending, number} pending
data.comment: A listing of a context's migrations, and how many the database lacks.

data.name: Added
data.comment: A migration added to a context.

data.name: AddedIn
data.comment: A migration added to a context, and the project's folder its files are in.

data.name: RemoveCancelled
data.comment: The person cancelled Remove Last Migration's question.

data.name: Removed
data.comment: A context's last migration removed.

data.name: UpdateCancelled
data.comment: The person cancelled the question about rolling migrations back.

data.name: Updated
data.value: {target, select, latest {Updated the database of {context} to the latest migration} none {Updated the database of {context} to before the first migration} other {Updated the database of {context} to {migration}}}
data.comment: The database updated: to the latest migration, to before the first (none), or to the migration named.

data.name: Scripted
data.value: {idempotent, select, yes {Scripted the migrations of {context}, idempotent, into {file}} other {Scripted the migrations of {context} into {file}}}
data.comment: A SQL script of a context's migrations written into a file, idempotent (yes) or not.

data.name: Bundled
data.comment: A program applying a context's migrations made at that path.

data.name: ReadingContexts
data.comment: The stage of reading which contexts the projects declare.

data.name: NoEfCoreIn
data.value: {project} does not use EF Core: choose the startup project that runs the context
data.comment: The chosen startup project's restore names no EF Core.

data.name: FixFirst
data.comment: What keeps dotnet ef from working ({gap}), and its fix's title, to run first.

data.name: Stopped
data.comment: A command stopped before it was done.

data.name: NoEfTool
data.value: dotnet ef is not installed here: {fix} first
data.comment: dotnet ef is not found for the startup project's folder, and the fix's title to run first.

data.name: FindingDatabase
data.comment: The stage of finding the database a context's migrations go to.

data.name: MigrationsUse
data.comment: The connection a context's migrations go to, found.

data.name: BuildStartupFirst
data.value: Build the startup project first: its restore says which EF Core it has
data.comment: A fix asked for before the startup project was ever restored.

data.name: FixCancelled
data.comment: The person cancelled a fix's question.

data.name: FixDone
data.comment: A fix of what kept dotnet ef from working, done ({fix}, its title).

data.name: ToolEnded
data.comment: A dotnet tool command (dotnet tool install, update or restore) that failed saying nothing, and its exit code said.

data.name: ReadingVersions
data.value: Reading which versions of {package} and EF Core fit…
data.comment: The stage of reading the package feeds for the versions of a provider and EF Core that fit together.

data.name: FeedsUnread
data.value: The feeds could not say which versions fit: {problem}
data.comment: The package feeds did not answer which versions fit.

data.name: NoFittingVersion
data.value: No version of {package} in the feeds supports EF Core {version}, and none of EF Core it supports is there
data.comment: No version of a provider package fits the EF Core version, nor any EF Core it supports.

data.name: PartlyAligned
data.value: {failed}; {changed} changed already, which Undo takes back
data.comment: A move of packages that failed partway ({failed}, what failed), and the projects it had changed already.

data.name: FileThere
data.comment: A design-time factory's file, already in the project.

data.name: FactoryAdded
data.value: Added {file}, which reads the connection string {connection}, as {told} names it, from the configuration
data.comment: A design-time factory added, reading the connection string the code names (told, where it is named).

data.name: FactoryAddedUnnamed
data.value: Added {file}, which reads the connection string {connection}: nothing in {startup} names {context}'s connection, so give it in appsettings.json's ConnectionStrings or as ConnectionStrings__{connection}
data.comment: A design-time factory added, reading a connection string of the context's name, which nothing in the startup project names.

data.name: Building
data.comment: The stage of building the startup project before dotnet ef runs.

data.name: ReadingRun
data.comment: The stage of reading the run configuration that runs the startup project.

data.name: RunningEf
data.comment: The stage of running dotnet ef for a command ({stage}, the command's own stage; {verb}, dotnet ef's verbs).

data.name: FailedFix
data.comment: A command that failed ({failed}, why) with the title of the fix the Migrations window offers.

data.name: Unnamed
data.comment: Add Migration given no name.

data.name: NoClassName
data.value: {name} is no C# name: a migration is a class of that name
data.comment: Add Migration given a name that is no C# class name.

data.name: NotEfCore
data.value: {startup} does not use EF Core: choose the startup project that runs the context
data.comment: A gap: the startup project chosen has no EF Core, so it cannot run the context.

data.name: ChooseStartupFix
data.comment: A fix's button: opens the Migrations window's startup project chooser.

data.name: NoToolFor
data.value: dotnet ef is not installed here, and {startup} has EF Core {runtime}
data.comment: A gap: no dotnet ef tool for the folder, and the EF Core version the startup project restored.

data.name: UpdateGlobalFix
data.comment: A fix's button: moves the person's global tool ({tool}, its package id) to the project's EF Core version.

data.name: ToolUnmatched
data.value: {place, select, local {The local {tool} {version}} other {The global {tool} {version}}} does not match {startup}'s EF Core {runtime}
data.comment: A gap: the dotnet ef tool found, local to the folder or the person's global one, is of another version than the startup project's EF Core.

data.name: LacksDesign
data.value: {startup} lacks {package}, which dotnet ef loads from the startup project
data.comment: A gap: the startup project lacks EF Core's Design package ({package}, its id).

data.name: DesignFix
data.comment: A fix's button: adds the Design package at the project's EF Core version.

data.name: ProviderBehind
data.comment: A gap: a database provider's package ({provider} {version}) supports other EF Core versions ({range}, as EF Core 9) than the startup project has.

data.name: AlignFix
data.value: Bring {provider} and EF Core into Step
data.comment: A fix's button: moves the provider's package or EF Core's packages so they fit each other.

data.name: PinFix
data.comment: A fix's button: installs the folder's local dotnet ef tool ({tool}, its package id) at the project's EF Core version.

data.name: NoHostRegisters
data.value: no host in {startup} registers it, and it has no parameterless constructor or design-time factory
data.comment: Why dotnet ef cannot make a context, said after "dotnet ef cannot make X:".

data.name: CannotMake
data.comment: A gap: dotnet ef could not make the context, and why ({why}, these words or EF's own).

data.name: FactoryFix
data.comment: A fix's button: adds an IDesignTimeDbContextFactory for the context, from a template.

data.name: SeveralContexts
data.value: The project has several contexts: choose one
data.comment: A gap: dotnet ef found more than one DbContext and was told none.

data.name: ChooseContextFix
data.comment: A fix's button: opens the Migrations window's context chooser.

data.name: NoContextFound
data.value: dotnet ef finds no DbContext in the project or the startup project
data.comment: A gap: dotnet ef found no context.

data.name: NoIdempotentScript
data.comment: A gap: an idempotent script was asked of a SQLite database, which EF Core cannot write.

data.name: ScriptPlainFix
data.comment: A fix's button and a question's answer: writes the script again without idempotence.

data.name: AppliedAlready
data.value: {migration} is applied to the database: update the database to the migration before it first
data.comment: A gap: removing a migration the database has applied.

data.name: ToolsUnrestored
data.value: The folder's local tools are not restored
data.comment: A gap: the folder's tool manifest names tools not yet restored.

data.name: RestoreToolsFix
data.comment: A fix's button: runs dotnet tool restore.

data.name: NoTool
data.value: dotnet ef is not installed here
data.comment: A gap: no dotnet ef tool for the folder.

data.name: EfEnded
data.comment: A command's failure where dotnet ef said nothing: how it ended ({exit}, as "exit code 1").

data.name: ToolOlder
data.value: The {tool} {version} run is older than {startup}'s EF Core {runtime}
data.comment: A gap after a command: the dotnet ef tool that ran ({tool} {version}) is older than the project's EF Core.

data.name: SupportsFrom
data.comment: The EF Core versions a provider's package supports: that version or any later.

data.name: SupportsOnly
data.comment: The EF Core version (or major version, as 9) a provider's package supports.

data.name: SupportsRange
data.comment: The EF Core versions a provider's package supports, from one version to another.

data.name: PackageMove
data.value: {move, select, downgrade {Downgrade {id} to {version} in {project}} other {Update {id} to {version} in {project}}}
data.comment: An update of an EF Core package in a project, as one step of Undo: moving it to an older version (downgrade) or a newer one.

data.name: UpdateAnyway
data.comment: A question's answer: updates EF Core's packages and leaves the provider behind.

data.name: UpdateSet
data.comment: A question's answer: moves EF Core's packages, and the provider with them, to that version.

data.name: UpdateTitle
data.comment: The title of the question asked before an update of an EF Core package leaves a provider behind.

data.name: LeavesBehind
data.comment: The question's first sentence: the provider's version and the EF Core versions it supports ({range}), which the update asked ({id} {version}) leaves.

data.name: OfferUp
data.value: {provider} {up} supports it: {together} moves EF Core's packages to {version} and {provider} to {up} together.
data.comment: The question's offer where a newer provider supports the EF Core asked; {together} is the answer's words (Update the Set to…).

data.name: OfferNone
data.value: No version of {provider} in the feeds supports EF Core {version} yet.
data.comment: The question's second sentence where no version of the provider supports the EF Core asked.

data.name: OfferBack
data.value: No version of {provider} in the feeds supports EF Core {version} yet; {back} moves EF Core's packages to {newest}, the newest it supports.
data.comment: The question's offer of EF Core's newest version the provider supports; {back} is the answer's words.

data.name: OfferBackWith
data.value: No version of {provider} in the feeds supports EF Core {version} yet; {back} moves EF Core's packages to {newest}, the newest it supports, and {provider} to {fits}.
data.comment: The question's offer of EF Core's newest version a newer provider ({fits}) supports; {back} is the answer's words.

data.name: AnywayNote
data.value: {anyway} moves EF Core's packages to {version} and leaves {provider} as it is.
data.comment: The question's last sentence: what the Update Anyway answer ({anyway}) does.

data.name: Sentences
data.comment: Two sentences said one after the other, the first ending in its own full stop.

data.name: MoveFailed
data.value: {name} failed: the NuGet window's log says why
data.comment: An update of EF Core's packages ({name}, as Update X to Y in Z) failed.

data.name: MoveDone
data.comment: An update of EF Core's packages ({name}) done.

data.name: MovedWith
data.comment: An update of EF Core's packages done, and the packages that moved with the one asked, each with its version.

data.name: Lacking
data.value: {count, plural, one {{packages} has no {version} in the feeds, left as it was} other {{packages} have no {version} in the feeds, left as they were}}
data.comment: EF Core's packages the feeds have no such version of, left as they were ({count}, how many).

data.name: BehindUp
data.value: {provider} {had} left behind, supporting {range}: {provider} {up} supports EF Core {version}
data.comment: An update that left a provider behind, and the provider's newer version that supports the EF Core it moved to.

data.name: BehindOlder
data.value: {provider} {had} left behind, supporting {range}: none of its versions in the feeds supports EF Core {version} yet; it supports EF Core {core}
data.comment: An update that left a provider behind, none of whose versions supports the EF Core it moved to; the newest EF Core it does support.

data.name: BehindOlderOther
data.value: {provider} {had} left behind, supporting {range}: none of its versions in the feeds supports EF Core {version} yet; {provider} {fits} supports EF Core {core}
data.comment: An update that left a provider behind, none of whose versions supports the EF Core it moved to; the provider's version that supports EF Core's newest it can.

data.name: BehindNone
data.value: {provider} {had} left behind, supporting {range}: none of its versions in the feeds supports EF Core {version} yet
data.comment: An update that left a provider behind, none of whose versions supports the EF Core it moved to.

data.name: AlignUp
data.comment: A provider's fix: its package moved to the version that supports the project's EF Core.

data.name: AlignCore
data.comment: A provider's fix: EF Core's packages moved to the newest version the provider supports.

data.name: RemoveQuestion
data.value: Remove {name}? Its files are deleted and the model snapshot goes back to the migration before it.
data.comment: Remove Last Migration's question.

data.name: RemoveUnreadQuestion
data.value: Remove {name}? Its files are deleted and the model snapshot goes back to the migration before it. The database could not be read, so whether it has the migration is not known.
data.comment: Remove Last Migration's question where the database could not be read.

data.name: Remove
data.comment: Remove Last Migration's question's answer.

data.name: RollBackTitle

data.comment: The title of the question asked before an update rolls migrations back.

data.name: RollBackQuestion
data.value: {target, select, none {Updating the database to before the first migration runs the Down method of {names} against it, which can lose the data they hold.} other {Updating the database to {migration} runs the Down method of {names} against it, which can lose the data they hold.}}
data.comment: The question asked before an update rolls migrations back ({names}, theirs): to before the first migration (none), or to the migration named.
